UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile containing authentication metadata, role persona, and preferences

displayName.description: Public display name of the user

role.description: Professional or personal persona (e.g. Interior Designer, Architect, Homeowner)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last modified

UserDesign.title: UserDesign
UserDesign.description: Saved 2D conceptual interior layouts and interactive 3D furniture meshes generated by the user

id.description: Unique identifier of the saved design item

userId.description: Firebase UID of the owning user

prompt.description: Text prompt specification used for generation

type.description: Format type of the design asset

mediaUrl.description: Access URL of the generated image or 3D GLB model

title.description: Descriptive style title of the spatial concept

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the design was generated or saved

/users/{userId}.description: User profile root document holding private identity and role specifications.

/users/{userId}/designs/{designId}.description: User's private collection of generated 2D room scenes and 3D architectural models.
